description: A random central triangle splits a square frame into a fan of seven flat-colored triangles from a mixed palette
notable: Corners of the canvas fan out to a randomly-placed interior triangle, partitioning the whole square with no gaps

description: Stacked horizontal bands filled by trochoidal (rolling-circle) wave curves, colors from Albers palettes, animated over time
notable: Trochoidal motion (radius offset on sin) gives the wave crests a leaning, ocean-swell shape rather than a plain sine

description: Layered trochoidal wave bands downscaled and Atkinson-dithered to a pixelated look; gamepad buttons tweak amplitude/frequency live
notable: Reads a joy-joy gamepad (X/B/Y/A) to nudge base frequency and amplitude in real time; optional grayscale ramp

description: The full A-Z alphabet built from extruded pixel-font voxel columns in isometric projection via the heerich engine
notable: Bitmap font drives box extrusion; tweakpane exposes letter stretch, extrusion height, and camera controls

description: A-Z alphabet from a 7-wide pixel font extruded into voxel columns, rendered in oblique projection with heerich
notable: Wider, rounder 7x9 bitmap font than the sibling alphabet sketch; oblique camera instead of isometric

description: A voxel octahedron (stacked diamond of unit cubes) rotating around Y with per-face directional shading, via heerich
notable: Layered Manhattan-radius rings form the diamond; rotation snaps to grid and dedupes voxels, faces shaded by quadrant

description: A single nalee space-filling walker path extruded into tall voxel columns, drawn as isometric boxes with oklch shading via heerich
notable: Bridges the nalee flow system into heerich voxels — the walker's path becomes a raised 3D ribbon of columns

description: Nalee walker path as voxel columns whose height is mapped from path length, giving a tapered isometric ribbon via heerich
notable: Column height eases from tall to short along the path length (mapRange over pts.length), so the ribbon reads as a ramp

description: Penplot variant of the nalee voxel path: white boxes with cross-hatched faces exported as an occluded A4 SVG via heerich
notable: Face hatching (per-face angle/period) plus heerich occlusion culling produce a plotter-ready line drawing on A4

description: Panna Meena ka Kund stepwell staircases rendered as interlocking oblique voxel terraces, with a back wall, via heerich
notable: Recreates the zigzag interlocking staircases of the Jaipur stepwell as tapering voxel steps in an alternating grid

description: Penplot version of the Panna Meena stepwell voxel terraces: black-outline white boxes exported as an occluded A4 SVG via heerich
notable: Same interlocking-staircase geometry as panna-meena but stripped to plotter line art with heerich hidden-face occlusion

description: A woven textile pattern of colored bands over a checkerboard ground built as a flat voxel grid in the style of Samantha Bittman, via heerich
notable: Oscillating band edges over a black/white checker mimic Bittman's hand-woven acrylic-on-textile op patterns

description: User-typed text extruded into voxel columns and slowly rotated around a chosen axis in orthographic projection via heerich
notable: Defaults to spelling HEERICH; tweakpane text field and X/Y/Z axis toggle drive an orthographic tumble of the word

description: A tiled diamond height field of voxel columns with Manhattan-distance coloring and pulsing palette cycling, in the Todd Kelly palette via heerich
notable: Manhattan distance to tiled diamond centers sets both color index and column height, so the field reads as raised pyramids

description: Scrolling tiled diamond voxel field (horizontal/vertical/diagonal drift) with distance-based height and color, Todd Kelly palette via heerich
notable: Randomly picks a scroll direction each run so the diamond pyramid field drifts across the plane

description: Concentric Chebyshev-distance staircase of voxel columns whose heights cycle between bowl and dome, echoing Panna Meena stepwell, via heerich
notable: A tent wave over Chebyshev distance from center makes the terraced field breathe between a concave bowl and a convex dome

description: A woven textile grid of striped warp/weft blocks with random highlight bands, Atkinson-dithered, in the manner of Wallace Sewell scarves
notable: Fine tick-mark warp lines plus random highlight weft bands, then dithered, evoke Wallace Sewell woven-scarf structure

description: Wave function collapse on a 12x12 grid of box-drawing pipe and block glyphs, drawn as blue line/fill tiles
notable: Earliest WFC iteration: adjacency rules over Unicode box-drawing and half-block chars, single blue ink

description: Wave function collapse with explicit edge-typed tiles and color-group families (blue/green/orange) on a 12x12 grid
notable: Reworks WFC with connect/empty edge constraints and per-tile color groups instead of a flat rule table

description: Wave function collapse of box-drawing pipe tiles on a 24x24 grid with per-cell random palette colors over a picked background
notable: Drops the block glyphs to pure pipework; each cell carries its own palette color for a confetti-of-lines look

description: Wave function collapse pipe network on a 32x32 grid where flood-filled connected runs share one chromotome color
notable: getAllConnectedCells recolors each contiguous pipe run one color, so continuous routes read as single-hued threads

description: Botanical wave function collapse: stem/branch/leaf/curve/split tiles with curve and thickness variation grow a vine-like network on a 24x24 grid
notable: Swaps pipe glyphs for plant morphemes (stems, leaves, splits) with per-cell curve/rotation jitter for an organic, botanical WFC

description: Wave function collapse pipes drawn as arrowed lines on a 32x32 grid, connected runs sharing a color, giving a directed-flow diagram
notable: Each pipe segment gets an arrowhead, turning the WFC network into a directed graph of flows

description: Wave function collapse pipes on a dense 64x64 grid, each stroke double-drawn as a colored band cored with the background for a tube look
notable: Over-strokes each pipe with a thin bg-colored inner line so the routes read as hollow ribbon-tubes at 64x64 resolution
